claim: Landing and demo scrubbing send and save no scrub input, and every public route loads no third-party tracking resources.
where: landing preview, demo banner, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; scrub distinct sentinels on landing and demo; seed real license/workspace keys before the ?demo=1 transition; visit every public route; assert the real keys stay byte-identical, no URL/body/store/cache contains input, and every request is same-origin

claim: The browser demo replaces emails, IPv4 addresses, credentials, bearer tokens, and JWTs; repeated values correlate only within one fresh demo case.
sandbox: fresh browser pages; submit every stated class and a repeated email; assert raw values are absent, typed replacements exist, repeats match within one page, and a fresh page uses a different token

claim: A returned license is saved locally, removable through site-storage clearing, and verified with Sociobot.
sandbox: fresh browser context; intercept the documented Sociobot verification endpoint; load a fixture return token; assert query removal, local token/verdict storage, the one expected endpoint, and removal after clearing local storage

claim: Reconnecting resumes verification of a saved license.
sandbox: prime the page; seed a stale saved license; reload offline; reconnect; fulfill the fixture Sociobot endpoint; assert exactly one verification and an active verdict

claim: The demo works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh browser context; activate service worker; clear HTTP cache; set offline; reload the demo and scrub new input

claim: casefile demo creates two bundled sample files and a real casefile in a new temporary directory, then prints both paths and its password.
sandbox: run JSON and human CLI demos from a clean checkout; assert two files, at least seven redactions, unique temporary roots, existing paths, password, and every printed detail

claim: Built-in rules replace private keys, URL and header credentials, quoted assignments, JWTs, emails, and IPv4 addresses.
sandbox: pack representative config; decrypt the entry and manifest; assert every seeded built-in class is absent and counted

claim: The CLI writes encrypted ZIP entries and a redaction manifest without matched values.
sandbox: pack seeded input; decrypt the file and manifest with the user password; assert raw values are absent

claim: The manifest records a salted fingerprint for each file, rule names, and hit counts without matched values.
sandbox: pack one file with three seeded classes; decrypt and parse the manifest; assert its per-file salted SHA-256 fingerprint, rule inventory, exact counts, and absence of every seeded value

claim: Every casefile ZIP entry uses AES-256 encryption.
where: landing workflow and pricing, CLI help, README
sandbox: pack seeded input; inspect every ZIP entry's AES metadata and assert Aes256

claim: The CLI reads casefile passwords from an environment variable, not a password command-line argument.
sandbox: inspect pack help; assert --password-env exists and no --password argument is accepted; pack successfully with a custom environment-variable name

claim: pack --json returns a machine-readable object for success, validation, and parse errors.
sandbox: invoke successful, validation-failure, and parse-failure pack commands with --json; parse each stdout object and assert empty stderr

claim: The CLI exits 0 on success, 2 for invalid input, and 1 for runtime failure.
sandbox: run successful, missing-input, and unwritable-output commands; assert exact process exit codes

claim: Project-owned JSON rules can replace a named value while preserving its context.
sandbox: pack a sample with the documented tenant rule; decrypt it and assert only the named capture changed

claim: Repeated values receive the same replacement within one CLI casefile, while another casefile uses a different replacement.
sandbox: run casefile pack twice on one file with repeated and distinct emails; decrypt both casefiles; compare same-file and cross-casefile tokens and inspect each token-scope statement

claim: A failed pack preserves an existing casefile and leaves no temporary archive; --force replaces that casefile.
sandbox: seed an existing casefile; run pack without --force and compare bytes and directory entries; rerun with --force and assert a valid replacement with no temporary file

claim: casefile inspect displays the manifest and can extract scrubbed files into a new temporary review directory.
sandbox: pack a nested sample; inspect without extraction; extract with the password; assert safe nested paths and scrubbed contents; assert a wrong password fails before extraction

claim: The MIT package exposes one CLI binary.
sandbox: read Cargo package metadata and assert the MIT license plus the only binary target is casefile

claim: The CLI contains no network or telemetry client.
sandbox: inspect clean Cargo metadata and CLI source for network and telemetry clients

claim: The $19 one-time team pack downloads four listed policy starters and a team review checklist after a cached valid license.
sandbox: seed a current valid verdict; assert price and checkout copy, then inspect the downloaded JSON rule names and checklist

claim: The landing page includes a self-hosted recording of the real casefile demo command.
sandbox: load the landing page; assert the labelled SVG recording is served from the same origin and its file/redaction summary matches a fresh real command
